items.title: Retail Investors Just Got a Lot More Bullish on the Market, Schwab Says
items.summary: Investors are expressing positive vibes about U.S. equities, despite ongoing concerns that the market is overvalued.  The report shows that 47% of retail clients are bullish on the U.S. stock market.  A separate report from The CFP Board also suggests that clients are more optimistic about their financial outlook this summer than they were three months ago.
